rationale: The requested clarification is a fresh change intent in an existing AGDF repository. With no approved durable UR, Brownfield decision, or supporting evidence, the earliest permissible stage is UR.
decision_grounds: Control state contains no approval and no Brownfield decision.
Brownfield Review and delivery-path selection require an approved durable UR first.
No delivery path can be evaluated before the required post-UR Brownfield Review and visible Mode/Slice Decision.
